speakers.name: Prof. Dr. LU, CHIHWEI
speakers.abstract:
"Conducting high-quality research is only the first step toward building a successful academic career. For young faculty members, effectively communicating research novelty, scientific contributions, and key findings is essential for gaining international recognition and establishing academic networks.
This workshop provides practical guidance on writing compelling conference abstracts, delivering effective presentations, and confidently engaging in academic discussions. Through real examples, interactive discussions, and personal experiences from international conferences and research collaborations, participants will learn how to strengthen their scientific communication, handle challenging questions, and transform conference participation into opportunities for professional growth and international collaboration.
The workshop aims to help young faculty members communicate their research with greater clarity, confidence, and impact."
speakers.talkTitle: Chủ đề: “From Good Research to International Recognition: Effective Abstract Writing, Conference Presentations, and Academic Communication for Young Faculty”
speakers.affiliation: Construction Engineering Department, National Taiwan University of Science and Technology
